rules.access-in-visibility: Who can see or work a ticket is decided only in app/visibility.py. Routes do not query Ticket, TeamMembership or TicketEscalator themselves unless the same function applies an app.visibility helper.
rules.agent-tickets-only-raising: Only app/raising.py creates source=agent tickets (backdating relies on it).
rules.messages-via-messages-module: What the requester may see, and whether a ticket can be emailed, is decided only in app/messages.py. Nothing else reads Ticket.messages or runs select() on Message.
rules.routers-only-from-main: Only app/main.py includes routers. Other modules do not import app.routers.*.
rules.tickets-via-ticket-service: Tickets are created and change status through app/ticket_service.py (numbers come from the models hook). Nothing else sets Ticket(...) directly outside the allowed modules.
